name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Playback compatibility and truthful diagnostics. Offers every compatible remote encoding, improves native Jellyfin app support including Android, shares measured capacity between sessions, and recovers web playback through fresh authorized sessions. Playback Info now reports the observed route, play method, conversion location and original/delivered formats instead of guessing Direct Play. Includes everything in 0.0.206.
